body_html:
"TTQA"
#smallpoems #edu307

Don't simply turn questions around
take twist and turns
shake fists and watch em burn
resist the
mental cysts of tools
that prexist

truth is kissed
when answers missed
instead of parroting for favor
kick em with a carrot

subsist as
a contortionist
reject
extortionist notions
BE free
an
alchemist with a potion
search emotion

let go
of pre-existing condition
design your own rendition
